# Navimower Map Card 0.3.0-beta1

## Completed sessions become compact mowed areas

This beta adds support for the completed-session render archives introduced by Navimower integration `0.4.0-beta1`.

- The active session remains the existing live polyline.
- Completed sessions are loaded from `/api/navimower/session-render/{entry_id}/{session_id}`.
- The mowed footprint is drawn as an SVG compound path with even-odd fill, retaining unmowed strips, no-mow areas, obstacle gaps, and temporary inaccessible areas.
- Dock departure, return-to-dock, pauses, and zone-to-zone travel remain visible as a separate compact stroked path.
- Completed session points and legacy daily line trails are never used as a visual fallback.

## Retained-day history and loading

- The History row now follows the retained session index instead of showing only three hard-coded days.
- Only completed renders needed by the selected day are requested.
- The card requests lightweight map payloads with `include_sessions=0&include_daily_trails=0`, sanitizes any legacy completed points returned by an older backend, and keeps only the active route in its own cache.
- Navimower `0.4.0-beta1` already provides the session index and render endpoints. A later integration update can honor the lightweight map query to remove the remaining completed-session bytes from the main response as well.

## Other completed card work

- The schedule dialog closes automatically after every changed day saves successfully; it stays open when validation or a service call fails.
- Card, map wrapper, and SVG sizing are constrained to the allocated Home Assistant grid width.
- Zone and map-detail strokes use non-scaling SVG outlines so visually similar zoom levels do not produce noticeably different line weights.
- The existing VF-off visibility option remains available and enabled by default.

## Compatibility

- Recommended backend: Navimower integration `0.4.0-beta1` or later.
- Existing YAML and visual-editor settings remain compatible.
- No additional JavaScript dependency is added. HACS installs the loader, stable core, and 0.3 archive layer from `dist/`.

## Testing requested

Please compare dashboard loading with one and multiple mowers, verify completed areas with real no-mow and temporary-obstacle gaps, check dock and inter-zone travel, test retained-day switching, and confirm the card stays inside narrow Sections and Masonry layouts.
